R. Q. 2 تَكَظْكَظَ He erected himself, sitting, as often as he filled his belly, (Lth, K,) becoming filled so that he could not breathe, (K,) after being seen to be in a bending posture, (Lth,) while eating. (K.) ―
-b2- It (a skin for water or milk) became filled, or full. (TA.) [See also 8, and R. Q. 1.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
